actors.name: Raffle operator
actors.description: Chooses a ticket number range, calls the generation endpoint, downloads and prints the DOCX. Coordinates issued ranges manually; no number ledger exists in the app.

actors.name: Developer / maintainer
actors.description: Edits ticket template and code, builds and tests, manages configuration and documentation. Template changes are file changes; no upload endpoint exists.

actors.name: Deployment operator
actors.description: Provisions the runtime, configures secrets and logging, deploys and rolls back, manually cleans orphaned files.

actors.name: Drive account owner
actors.description: Grants OAuth consent for Google Drive and can revoke credentials. Only relevant if the Drive client is resolved; the ticket route never uses it.

systems.name: Ticket Mapper
systems.description: ASP.NET Core 8 Web API that stamps an inclusive integer range onto a PNG ticket template and returns a Word document. Built for the Lake George Alumni Association fall 2023 raffle. No frontend, no sales database, no payment flow, no persisted number allocation.

systems.name: Google OAuth / Drive
systems.description: External Google account and Drive service. Adapter code exists and is DI-registered, but the ticket endpoint never calls it. No live grant or API call has been verified.

systems.name: Document viewer / print workflow
systems.description: Manual downstream activity: the operator reviews and prints the downloaded DOCX outside the app. No viewer or printer integration exists.

containers.name: API process
containers.description: Single ASP.NET Core process hosting controllers, MediatR, ImageSharp rendering, file I/O, and the optional Drive adapter.

containers.name: RabbitMQ scaffold
containers.description: RabbitMQ 3-management deployed by Docker Compose. No application producer, consumer, or queue code references it; it has no business edge to ticket generation.

components.name: Program.cs startup
components.description: Application entry point. Configures DI, middleware, Swagger, Serilog, and the host lifecycle.

components.name: DocumentController
components.description: GET /api/v1/Document/DownloadDocument?startNumber=&endNumber=. Orchestrates create, read, cleanup notification, and returns Tickets.docx.

components.name: MediatR wiring
components.description: In-process Send/Publish. Handlers registered as transient; all messaging is in-process, not a message bus.

components.name: CreateDocumentCommandHandler
components.description: Renders tickets: loads the PNG template, resolves Arial 30, clones the template per number, draws the number at (120,290), saves ticket_<n>.png, embeds into DOCX, deletes the PNG. Uses ImageSharp, OpenXML and System.IO directly.

components.name: GetDocumentQueryHandler
components.description: Reads the complete DOCX into a byte array via the filesystem abstraction. Rethrows errors; does not forward the cancellation token.

components.name: TimeToDeleteNotificationHandler
components.description: Consumes the in-process TimeToDeleteNotification and sends a DeleteDocumentCommand. This is an in-process MediatR notification, not a message-bus event.

components.name: DeleteDocumentCommandHandler
components.description: Best-effort file delete plus existence check via the filesystem abstraction. Swallows errors after logging.

components.name: IFileSystem abstraction
components.description: Read/delete abstraction used by the get and delete handlers only. The create handler bypasses it with direct file I/O.

components.name: GoogleDrive adapter
components.description: Upload, download, delete, list, and metadata operations against Google Drive. Implemented but unused: no ticket-route caller exists.

components.name: DriveService factory + OAuth
components.description: Loads client_secrets.json, requests full Drive scope, fixed user key, on-disk token cache. Blocks on .Result.

components.name: Settings binder
components.description: Binds user-secrets and environment variables. The checked-in appsettings.json is NOT loaded.

components.name: Serilog config
components.description: Logging configuration. The active sink is unverified.

components.name: GoogleDriveRepository
components.description: Placeholder repository boundary. Injects the Drive adapter but exposes no business methods.

components.name: FileIO project
components.description: Empty infrastructure project; not referenced by the solution.

externalDependencies.name: NuGet packages
externalDependencies.description: MediatR 11.1, ImageSharp 3.0.1, DocumentFormat.OpenXml 3.0, System.IO.Abstractions 20.0.4, Google.Apis.Drive.v3, Serilog 3.1.1, Swashbuckle 6.5. No lock file; no dependency audit.

externalDependencies.name: Ticket.png template
externalDependencies.description: Source PNG ticket template. Numbers are stamped at coordinates (120,290) in Arial 30.

flows.name: Ticket generation and cleanup
flows.description: Operator requests a number range; the API renders each ticket, assembles the DOCX, returns it, then deletes the server-side file.

steps.label: Request ticket range
steps.description: Operator calls GET /api/v1/Document/DownloadDocument with startNumber and endNumber.

steps.label: Dispatch create command
steps.description: Controller builds ticket details and sends CreateDocumentCommand via MediatR.

steps.label: Render tickets
steps.description: Handler clones the PNG template per number, draws the number, embeds each PNG into the DOCX, deletes the PNG.

steps.label: Read DOCX bytes
steps.description: Controller reads the complete DOCX into memory via the get handler.

steps.label: Delete server file
steps.description: Notification handler sends DeleteDocumentCommand; the handler best-effort deletes the DOCX.

steps.label: Return Tickets.docx
steps.description: Controller returns HTTP 200 with the buffered document.

flows.name: Rendering or read failure
flows.description: Per-ticket exceptions are caught and logged while the loop continues, so a 200 response can carry an incomplete document.

steps.label: Ticket render throws
steps.description: A per-ticket exception is caught, logged, and the loop continues with the next number.

steps.label: Incomplete DOCX returned as 200
steps.description: The assembled document may be missing tickets but is still returned successfully.

steps.label: Read failure becomes 500
steps.description: If the DOCX cannot be read, the get handler rethrows and the controller returns 500.

flows.name: Request cancellation
flows.description: The render loop has no explicit cancellation check; a disconnected client may receive no response.

steps.label: Client disconnects mid-render
steps.description: No explicit cancellation check exists in the ticket loop.

steps.label: Cancellation surfaces as 400/500
steps.description: Escaped cancellation maps to 400; other failures to 500.

flows.name: Cleanup failure leaves orphans
flows.description: The delete handler swallows failures after logging; PNG orphans from render errors are never cleaned.

steps.label: Delete fails silently
steps.description: DeleteDocumentCommandHandler logs the failure and swallows it.

steps.label: Orphan PNGs accumulate
steps.description: Intermediate PNGs from failed renders are never removed by the DOCX cleanup path.
